_about: Labelled film5 scenes. Labels come from the author's eye (FAIL) or from a cut he accepted after the physics loop (PASS), never from a judge. calibrate.py runs the groundedness judge over these and reports agreement. Paths are relative to takes/.

coaster.brief: A couple on a roller coaster mid-drop, the man opening a small ring box to propose, both screaming with joy, confetti whipped by the wind, golden hour.
propositions: two riders, a couple, are visible in the same coaster car (a solo rider fails)
the object in the man's hand is a small ring box; a phone, a tablet or any other object fails
exactly one ring box exists; a second box or a second hand holding one fails
both riders stay seated in the car; anything visible of the car, track or restraints is coherent (out of frame is fine)

umbrella.brief: Two rain-soaked strangers laughing together under one shared umbrella at night on a city street, warm bokeh lights behind them.
propositions: one umbrella shared by two people
the object overhead is an umbrella with a canopy and a handle; a tablet, a screen or any flat rigid object fails
the scene reads as rain (wet surfaces, spray, droplets or streaks) and both people are under the canopy
night street with lights behind them

meter.brief: A man in a soaked business suit screaming furiously at a parking meter in the rain, gesturing with whole-arm movements, deadpan wide framing.
propositions: a parking meter exists in frame (no meter fails)
the man's anger is directed at the meter: he stands at it and engages it at some point (a glance up at the sky mid-rant is fine)
the scene reads as rain-soaked (wet street, wet suit, matted hair, spray or streaks)
the body is in possible poses with the arms doing something angry (any gesture size is fine)

copier.brief: An office worker calmly photocopying her own face, lifting the copier lid as printed copies of her face stack in the tray, fluorescent office light.
propositions: she is photocopying her own live face: her face goes to the copier (on or right over the glass, lid up or down) at some point; copying a printed photograph of her face instead fails
the copier produces prints and, where a print is visible, it shows her face
the copier stays a coherent machine: lid, glass and tray in their places, and no head or body part sits inside the tray or the housing
one woman with one body in an office throughout

dog.brief: A child at a kitchen chalkboard patiently teaching calculus to a golden retriever sitting attentively at a tiny desk, evening lamp light.
propositions: a golden retriever sits at a tiny desk
a child stands at a chalkboard
the chalkboard carries math-like marks; any lettering is not readable words
child and dog bodies are in possible poses with constant scale

granny.brief: A grandmother drag-racing a mobility scooter down a supermarket aisle, groceries flying from the basket, shelves blurring past.
propositions: the rider is an elderly woman, a grandmother, with grey or white hair and an aged face (use the detail frame); a young woman or a man fails
groceries in flight are leaving the scooter's basket or trailing behind it; items appearing far from the basket with no path from it fail (an item entering from just off frame is fine)
the scene is a supermarket aisle with shelves
the scooter and rider stay one coherent body at constant scale
